fork_status_and_schedule.highlight: glamsterdam-devnet-8 (Platåberget) launched; Gloas activates ~1 week out (Thursday 7:50 AM UTC)
Gas repricing numbers final: EIP-2780/8037/8038 specs unchanged; 200M gas limit confirmed safe for Glamsterdam (>3x current 60M)
EIP-8261 (in-client gas limit schedule via CL config): majority of CL clients approved; moves forward as optional parameter

eip_proposals_hegota.highlight: EIP-7923 (Linear Page-Based Memory Costing): replaces quadratic memory pricing; jochem championing; spec update + max-memory report in 2 weeks
EIP-3298 (Remove Refunds): proposal to remove storage-clearing refund only; EIP-7702 refund handling to be discussed async
EIP-5920 (PAY opcode): send ETH without executing foreign code; jochem will champion if no existing champion
EIP-8358 (Net Gas Metering for Account Changes) and EIP-8374 (Persist Warm Access Sets Across Reverts): both PFI'd by draganrakita; Danno flags 8374 implementation complexity
EIP-8368 (CPSB Recalibration): small constant adjustment to EIP-8037 needed when scaling gas limit toward 600M; Toni presenting on Maria's behalf
EIP-8355 (ML-DSA precompile): FIPS 204, all 3 security levels, compressed keys; widely supported in client languages by Hegota ship date
EIP-8372 (Normalized State Gas Limit): one-time fork-boundary calibration of state gas cost/limit to correct over/under-demand after Glamsterdam
EIP-8375 (eMBER, ePBS Mandatory Burn): burns % of execution rewards via priority fee floor + PBS observer floor; lightclient flags ePBS adoption uncertainty
EIP-8219 (Checked Arithmetic Opcodes): safe add/sub/mul/div opcodes reverting on overflow; reduces Solidity safe-math from ~79 gas to ~5 gas; alternative single-opcode+immediate proposed
EIPs 7971, 8058, 7609, 7973, 8360 (proposed by helkomine): no champion present; nixo to contact helkomine for next ACDE or PRs will be closed

history_expiry.highlight: History expiry needed for 2TB node operators at Hegota given 200M gas limit; no consensus on cutoff — Nethermind targets ~6 months, Erigon ~1 year, Geth fork-minus-100K blocks, Besu 5 months
Ben Adams: clients must coordinate on same expiry window or history syncing breaks; discussion deferred to ETH R&D history-expiry channel

native_aa.highlight: Frames (EIP-8141) status: Geth, Nethermind, ethrex support; Besu not opposed; Reth no stance; Erigon supportive; strong pushback from Base/OP (EIP-8130) and Arbitrum on L2 DoS/TPS concerns
Offchain Labs: static/pure-function validation frames mode would resolve L2 DoS concern; static frames workstream already in progress per Derek (Ethlabs)
Decision deferred: AA breakout on Aug 25 (14:00 UTC) to compare 8141 vs 8130 and surface required modifications; ACDE #244 (Aug 27) to make final implementation decision

action_items.action: Converge on single history expiry window number and decide where to spec it

action_items.action: Bring concrete 8141 vs 8130 comparison and required-modification list to AA breakout Aug 25

decisions.decision: Gas repricing numbers final; no spec changes needed; 200M gas limit confirmed for Glamsterdam
EIP-8261 (in-client gas limit schedule) moves forward as optional CL config parameter

PFI for Hegota: EIP-7923 (Linear Memory Costing), EIP-3298 (Remove Refunds), EIP-5920 (PAY opcode), EIP-8358 (Net Gas Metering for Account Changes), EIP-8374 (Persist Warm Access Sets), EIP-8368 (CPSB Recalibration), EIP-8077 (announce txs with nonce), EIP-8094 (blob-aware mempool), EIP-8355 (ML-DSA precompile), EIP-8372 (Normalized State Gas Limit), EIP-8375 (eMBER), EIP-8219 (Checked Arithmetic Opcodes)
EIPs 7971, 8058, 7609, 7973, 8360 not PFI'd; nixo to contact helkomine for next ACDE opportunity, otherwise PRs closed
Native AA implementation decision (Frames/8141 vs 8130) deferred to AA breakout Aug 25 + ACDE Aug 27
EL client preference lists for Hegota PFIs due by September 10th (ACDE #245)
